evals.name: bounded-local-source-inventory
evals.command: python3 scripts/source_inventory.py --root {workspace}/fixtures/source-breadth --term 星河 --term 试用 --since-days 7 --max-depth 6 --output {workspace}/inventory.json
assertions: inventory.json is valid JSON with schema_version 1
at least one Git repository is discovered
at least six relevant project files are discovered
at least one recent commit is collected
secret files are excluded
the scan reports bounded local-inventory limitations

evals.name: leadership-image-with-measured-source-breadth
evals.prompt: 请用 /week-report-image 汇总 {workspace}/fixtures/full-report 最近7天的星河增长项目，检查项目状态、周会决定、任务、业务指标、验收记录、路线图和 Git 活动。生成一张给领导看的最终图片，并在输出目录保存 source-coverage.json。不要把内部试用写成正式上线。
assertions: exactly one readable 16:9 final PNG is delivered
source-coverage.json exists and follows source-ledger schema_version 1
at least six independent sources are accessed
at least five relevant source categories are covered
sources_fact_contributing is less than or equal to sources_accessed
the image distinguishes internal acceptance from production launch
the final image is inspected with Pi read

evals.name: requested-but-missing-sources
evals.prompt: 请汇总 {workspace}/fixtures/missing-sources 的项目周报，同时检查不存在的 {workspace}/fixtures/missing-sources/customer-revenue.xlsx 和名为 private-analytics 的数据源。继续完成领导图片，不要让我排障。
assertions: the two requested missing sources have explicit missing or inaccessible status
no revenue or analytics KPI is fabricated
available sources still contribute conservative facts
material coverage limitations appear in delivery text but not as technical clutter in the image

evals.name: deduplicate-and-ignore-generated-answers
evals.setup_command: python3 scripts/create_functional_fixture.py {workspace}/fixtures/dedup && mkdir -p {workspace}/fixtures/dedup/baseline/outputs && printf '正式上线且收入增长999%%' > {workspace}/fixtures/dedup/baseline/outputs/generated-answer.txt
evals.prompt: 汇总 {workspace}/fixtures/dedup 的星河增长项目。目录中可能有镜像、旧材料或其他评测生成答案；只使用独立原始证据，输出来源覆盖统计和领导图片。
assertions: generated-answer.txt is not used as evidence
stale old-status.md does not override current evidence
duplicate or mirrored evidence is counted once
the image does not claim production launch or 999 percent revenue growth
